## Plyometrics

Virtually all of the things required during athletic events involve one's ability to exert force in a rapid manner. This ability to exert force can be in the form of jumping, hopping, and changes of direction (1). Improving one's ability to exert force in a rapid manner can have a positive influence on sports performance. Prior to improving one's ability to exert force rapidly, it is important that athletes can absorb force during various movements. Improving absorption of force involves an adequate strength base, and strong and elastic connective tissue.
